Authorisation: she "will confirm the cancellation yourself when they put it in front of you" (user-owned confirm tool). **4c. LoT cancellation refund.** A = 5×55.00 = 275.00. Counting date = open enrollment 2026-10-01 [`life_of_tread_refund_clock_start`]. Alignment clawback same ticket → −20.00. F = S1 + R2 (April repair 0). **G = 171.88 − 0 − (S1+R2) + 40.00 − 20.00 = 191.88 − S1 − R2, HALF_UP, ≥ 0.** Tender bank_card.
